user.title: Import an Alfred session
user.description: Paste the auth object exported locally from WebViewer. Close WebViewers using this session without signing out. Secrets will be stored in Home Assistant. Use a new, unexposed session.

cameras.title: Select cameras
cameras.description: Snapshots are fetched on demand. Automatic refresh is experimental, disabled by default, and may rotate Alfred refresh credentials.

data.cache_seconds: Minimum cache duration in seconds (30 to 3600)

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired session. Export a new session.

abort.wrong_account: The session belongs to another account.

init.title: Alfred snapshot options
init.description: Experimental automatic refresh may rotate credentials on Alfred. Keep other WebViewers using this session closed. Cache limits requests; it does not schedule captures.
